Card Q&A.q: What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If [Cyberdramon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may place 1 Option card with the [Device] trait from your hand or trash in the battle area.
[When Digivolving] By trashing 1 of your Option cards in the battle area, ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 of your Option cards in the battle area, trash your opponent's top security card.
